title: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker, former apprentice of Karn, who seeks Karn to stop the Phyrexians and ultimately donates his spark to him.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker haunted by her past complicity with Phyrexian torturers, who confronts her fears to help the quest.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A Mirran planeswalker bent on destroying Phyrexians in their lair.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The planeswalker creator of Mirrodin, driven mad by Phyrexian corruption, who is restored when Venser gives him his spark.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who works with the mad Karn and attacks the trio at the core.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An envoy from Esper who aids the trio, rescues Melira, and betrays Glissa, serving Bolas's interests.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A vampire who uses a grate with his pod and reports intruders to Glissa.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A woman immune to phyresis who cures the infected and cleanses Karn.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: A renegade elf who leads the Mirran resistance.

entities.name: Vadi
entities.description: A hermit shaman who convinces Elspeth to face her fears.

entities.name: Maalan
entities.description: A loxodon who brings the party to Ezuri's village.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whose interests Tezzeret serves.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders occupying Mirrodin and compleating its inhabitants.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane created by Karn, being overrun by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A toxic swamp feeding the world's blackest souls that has encroached on the Oxidda Chain.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: A Phyrexian lair where the trio are captured and about to be experimented on.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: A layer of Mirrodin's interior where Maalan's warriors meet the party.

events.summary: In the Oxidda Chain Venser disables a leveler, and in Koth's village Koth's compleated mother attacks them and they destroy her.
events.quote: she has become compleated and attempts to kill them

events.summary: Elspeth has a panic attack after a fight with nim and a Phyrexian zombie and leaves.
events.quote: Elspeth has a panic attack and leaves

events.summary: Vadi threatens Elspeth for cowardice, then explains she must face her fears and end the Phyrexian threat.
events.quote: the only good Elspeth can do now is to face her fears and end the Phyrexian threat

events.summary: Venser reveals to Koth that he is actually seeking Karn.
events.quote: Venser had revealed to Koth that he is actually seeking Karn

events.summary: Venser and Koth are captured in the Mephidross and brought to the Phyrexian lair at Ish Sah.
events.quote: taken capture and brought into their lair at Ish Sah

events.summary: Koth escapes by melting his manacles and Elspeth kills the Phyrexians and frees Venser.
events.quote: Elspeth steps through, killing the Phyrexians and freeing Venser

events.summary: Elspeth confesses she was complicit with Phyrexians who tortured prisoners on her plane.
events.quote: she was complicit with the Phyrexians who tortured prisoners on her plane

events.summary: The trio reaches the Mirran resistance led by Ezuri.
events.quote: there encounter the Mirran resistance, led by the renegade elf, Ezuri

events.summary: Geth reports to Glissa and the mad Karn, and Glissa sends Tezzeret to bring Elspeth to her.
events.quote: Karn has gone mad and keeps dripping glistening oil

events.summary: Tezzeret dispatches a crusher attacking the trio and leads them to the Surgical Bay.
events.quote: Tezzeret leads the others to the Surgical Bay

events.summary: After killing her tormenters, Tezzeret reveals that Melira is immune to phyresis and wants her in the resistance's hands, defying Glissa.
events.quote: This act of defying the wishes of Glissa

events.summary: Melira starts curing villagers infected with phyresis at Ezuri's camp.
events.quote: she starts curing them with her powers

events.summary: At the core Melira cleanses Karn, making him sweat glistening oil.
events.quote: Melira uses her power to cleanse his body, making him sweat glistening oil

events.summary: Tezzeret betrays Glissa as she attacks with Phyrexians.
events.quote: is suddenly stopped by a surprise betrayal by Tezzeret

events.summary: Venser donates his spark and heart to Karn, who reignites and regains his memories and vows to stop the Phyrexians.
events.quote: donating his spark to the golem, who instantly reignites and regains his memories and personality

relations.note: Venser is Karn's former apprentice and friend.
relations.quote: former apprentice and friend of the Planeswalker Karn
the Mirran resistance, led by the renegade elf, Ezuri
Geth returns to report on the intruders to Glissa
is suddenly stopped by a surprise betrayal by Tezzeret
